summary: This document describes how signaling intermediaries, often called Session Border Controllers, behave when performing Hosted NAT Traversal for real-time media. It covers media relaying and latching, which let devices behind NATs communicate. It is non-normative.

eli5.summary: Devices behind home routers cannot be reached directly. A helper in the middle notices where the first packets come from and then sends replies back there. This RFC describes that trick.
